intro: {{count}} published MBA / PGDM colleges in Pune have a recorded average package higher than their recorded total fee. This shortlist of the best MBA / PGDM colleges in Pune where average package exceeds fees should be read with the programme name on each card.

NICMAR University is listed first, but the card is for a PGP in Health, Safety and Environment Management, not a general MBA. Allana Institute follows with MBA in Production and Operations Management.
There is no separate Pune MBA listing page on our site at present, so use the Maharashtra listing alongside this article when you want the wider city and state set.
listLead: These are the top MBA / PGDM colleges in Pune 2026 that pass this fee–package filter in our records. One college has no ownership type on file, and several first cards are specialised programmes rather than a flagship MBA.
snapshot: Among the {{feeN}} colleges with a recorded fee, the median total is {{feeMedian}}, and the middle half sits between {{feeP25}} and {{feeP75}}.
{{private}} colleges are private, and one has no ownership type in our records. Recorded average packages range from {{pkgMin}} to {{pkgMax}}, from {{pkgYearMin}} to {{pkgYearMax}}.
CAT and MAH MBA CET are the main recorded entrance tests, with ATMA also appearing. The highest recorded package is {{highestMax}}, which is not the average.
firstCollegesLead: NICMAR's recorded 2023 average of ₹9 lakh belongs to the PGP HSEM card, with a fee of about ₹3.75 lakh. Confirm the official fee and placements for the MBA or ACM programme if that is the course you want.
Dhole Patil College of Engineering shows MBA Financial Management at ₹35,000. A figure that low is often an annual or partial tuition, so open the official notice before you compare it with packages.

sections.heading: Specialised programmes on the Pune value list
paragraphs: IIMS Pune is listed with a PGDM in Supply Chain and Operations Management. RIIM Pune's card is titled MBA Employability Index, which is not a standard degree name.
When the title is unusual, treat our fee and package as a lead to the official brochure, not as the last word.

compare.heading: How to judge the best MBA / PGDM colleges in Pune where average package exceeds fees
paragraphs: Pune has many private B-schools with similar recorded averages around ₹5–7 lakh. The difference often sits in the official fee, the CET cut-off and the programme focus.
bullets: The full official fee for the exact MBA, MMS or PGDM, not only the specialised title on our card.
Whether the latest intake uses MAH MBA CET, CAT or ATMA, and the category cut-off.
The official placement report year, which on this list runs from {{pkgYearMin}} to {{pkgYearMax}}.

faqs.question: How many MBA colleges in Pune have an average package above fees?
faqs.answer: We list {{published}} published colleges in Pune on this filter. Colleges without both a recorded fee and a recorded average package are left out.

faqs.question: Is NICMAR's first-card fee the cost of its MBA?
faqs.answer: Not necessarily. Our first card is a PGP in Health, Safety and Environment Management, with a recorded fee of about ₹3.75 lakh and a 2023 average of ₹9 lakh. Check the official MBA or ACM fee if that is your target programme.

faqs.question: Which exams do these Pune colleges accept?
faqs.answer: CAT is the most frequently recorded test, followed by MAH MBA CET and ATMA. Confirm the current CAP or institute-level process on the official admission page.

faqs.question: Why is one Pune MBA fee as low as ₹35,000?
faqs.answer: Dhole Patil College of Engineering is listed with MBA Financial Management at ₹35,000 in our records. That may be an annual or partial fee, so confirm the official full-programme amount.

faqs.question: Are the placement figures guaranteed?
faqs.answer: No. They are historical records from {{pkgYearMin}} to {{pkgYearMax}}. Use the latest official placement report for the same programme.
